data.title: 春原瞬 · 梅花园庭院的午后品茗
data.description: 山海经梅花园充满古典韵味的阳光庭院，翠竹摇曳，微风送来清雅的花香。瞬端坐在雕花木石凳前，深红刺绣高叉旗袍勾勒出绝美的曼妙身段。她单手轻托青瓷茶杯，美眸含情脉脉地望向老师，嘴角漾开一抹极致包容与慈爱的成熟笑意。
data.location: traditional Shanhaijing plum blossom courtyard garden
data.action: sitting gracefully holding celadon tea cup, serene maternal gaze, gentle smile
data.lighting: bright natural daylight filtering through green bamboo leaves
data.mood: peaceful elegance, tranquil warmth, and gentle charm
data.promptProse: Sitting gracefully in a tranquil bamboo garden holding a delicate tea cup, Sunohara Shun gazes forward in her crimson embroidered qipao with a serene, doting smile.
data.animaCaption: Shun smiling gently while sipping tea in the sunny plum blossom courtyard.
